window.label: fresh 30-day v1.4 replay window (completed matches only)

Bundesliga.note: No fixture in the replay window had enough pre-match evidence under the same-season minimum-history rule before the cutoff.

replayRules.chronology: For every fixture, only matches with an earlier date in the same league/season were used.
replayRules.minimumHistory: At least 3 earlier matches for each team, at least 1 earlier home match for the home team, and at least 1 earlier away match for the away team. Missing evidence means no Core-ready selection.
replayRules.lambda: Goal expectancy uses 35% team recent GF + 35% opponent recent GA + 15% venue GF + 15% opponent venue GA; each lambda is clamped to 0.20–3.50.
replayRules.probability: 70% Poisson market probability + 15% recent empirical market frequency + 15% venue empirical market frequency.
replayRules.footballGate: Probability >=65%; recent-form support; home/away support; goals-profile support; Poisson support >=65%; two independent empirical checks both supporting; no major disagreement.
replayRules.selection: If more than one market passes, use the highest football probability for that fixture.

limitations: This is a fresh replay of the v1.4 football-evidence gate, not a replay of older predictions.

Historical same-bookmaker price snapshots were not available in the OpenFootball dataset, so the +4pp no-vig edge and +5% EV price gates were not applied. Therefore these are football-qualified selections, not fully price-verified Core bets.
The source currently exposes these 8 2026/27 leagues in a consistent machine-readable format; this is not the project's full global live scan universe.
Early-season fixtures are intentionally excluded when current-season evidence is incomplete rather than backfilled with future results or older-version predictions.
